card.name: Escudo Drenador
card.summary: Negue o ataque declarado por um oponente e, se ele for negado, ganhe PV iguais ao ATK atual do atacante.

textEvidence.text: Draining Shield. On an opposing attack declaration, target its attacker and negate that attack. Only when it actually negates the attack does its controller gain LP equal to the current ATK of that target. It does not end the phase and cannot gain LP a second time for an already negated attack. Normal Trap, no cost. Negating the activation prevents the effect.

card.name: Aparelho de Evacuação Obrigatória
card.summary: Escolha um monstro de qualquer lado; devolva-o à mão do dono. Monstros do Deck Adicional voltam para lá.

textEvidence.text: Compulsory Evacuation Device. Target one monster on either field, including a Set monster, then return that physical card to its owner. A Fusion Monster returns to its owner’s Extra Deck and a Token disappears. A vanished target is not replaced. Normal Trap, no cost. Negating the activation prevents the effect.

card.name: Presa de Serpente
card.summary: Escolha um monstro com a face para cima; ele perde 500 DEF até o fim deste turno.

textEvidence.text: Snake Fang. Target one face-up monster on either field; reduce its DEF by 500 until the end of this turn. It may be used in the Damage Step before damage calculation. Normal Trap, no cost. Negating the activation prevents the effect.

card.name: Máscara da Fraqueza
card.summary: Escolha um monstro que esteja atacando; ele perde 700 ATK até o fim deste turno.

textEvidence.text: Mask of Weakness. Target one attacking monster of either player. That target loses 700 ATK until the end of the turn. It can be used before damage calculation, and cannot be used without an attacking monster. Normal Trap, no cost. Negating the activation prevents the effect.

card.name: Escoar Energia
card.summary: Escolha um monstro seu com a face para cima. Ele ganha 200 ATK e DEF por carta que o oponente tiver na mão na resolução, até o fim do turno.

textEvidence.text: Energy Drain. Target one face-up monster you control. When this effect resolves, use the current number of cards in the opposing hand; the target gains 200 ATK and DEF for each card counted until the end of this turn. Subsequent hand changes do not alter the applied amount. Normal Trap, no cost. Negating the activation prevents the effect.
